composition: Paper field. Large split headlines. A 3D object (wheel) marks transitions. Process steps listed as a long vertical itinerary. Team first-names appear as a quiet strip.
typography: Editorial grotesque, large measure-breaking headlines that animate per letter or per word. Body is short and concrete.
palette: #F6F8FA paper, #1C272D ink. Two stops. No neon AI accent.
geometry: Long itinerary of process steps. Headlines can exceed a comfortable measure on purpose, then wrap. Wheel sits off the text column.
navigation: Scroll is the tour. Minimal chrome. Contact lives in an interactive footer.
hero: Name + one-line definition + 'Scroll to explore'. No CTA pair.
motion: Scroll-tied narrative. 3D transitions between beats. Headline micro-moves. Loader as a short constructed intro.
interaction: Hover on headlines and footer. Wheel reacts. Form in the footer is part of the scene.
imagery: Almost no photography. Abstract process objects + type.
materials: Paper, ink, one physical 3D object. Rapier physics on selected objects.
spatial_rhythm: Quiet paper → process list → domain statements → team → interactive close.
responsive: Pacing retimed. 3D wheel simplified or still. Headlines re-break earlier.
signature_motif: Stealth process-itinerary on paper with one sculptural chapter object
